direction_audit_20261023.method: Offline reconstruction of each scored stock entry using identical closed five-day cash-candle history and current signal configuration. Signed cash movements use actual entry open and later closed prices; positive means the selected option direction was favorable. This is a diagnostic, not a reversed-option backtest.

plan.purpose: Entry and exit path diagnosis; no production parameter promotion
plan.validation_status: Previously inspected history; exploratory, not untouched holdout

policies.trend_alignment: Enter only if last completed 15-minute EMA10 slope and confirmation close versus EMA agree with selected side
policies.wait_one_close: Wait for next five-minute close; require directional candle and hold beyond original confirmation close, no more than 0.5 original 5m ATR extension; enter next observed option open
policies.net_breakeven_1R: After observed premium high reaches both 1 initial-risk unit and net breakeven price, protect net breakeven from following bar, retaining existing trailing rule

plan.sizing: Candidate lots cannot exceed original trade lots, risk cap unchanged; actual new entry open repriced
plan.comparison: Paired original entry opportunities; filtered or delayed entries do not rerun scanner/ranking, learning, replacement entries or portfolio wallet. Not a deployable strategy backtest.
plan.promotion: No production promotion from this retrospective sample; require a future paper sample with net-positive expectancy, bounded drawdown and sufficient trades
